integrity: The upper bound uses the primary source's stated recursive enumerability of ML refutability and recursive axiomatizability of Skvo. The lower bound composes Berger's Pi^0_1-complete ordinary tileability problem with a fixed strongly aperiodic Wang factor and the source's two canonical-formula equivalences, which separately detect periodic tileability and ordinary tileability. The product construction is proved directly by coordinate projection and pairing.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies the computability-theoretic complexity of the full formula difference ML\Skvo. It does not provide polynomial-time bounds, formula-size optimality, or a corresponding result for restricted-variable fragments.
title: The Medvedev–Skvortsov separation set is co-r.e.-complete
